name: QTT Product Role
description: One row per role a product declares as valid for its own QTT Product Access.product_role field — e.g. Instructor/Student for QMP LMS. The platform never hardcodes these values; each product owns its own catalog.

fields.label: Role Key
fields.description: The literal value stored in QTT Product Access.product_role — e.g. 'Instructor'.
